text: Database queries should stay in the repository layer instead of controllers.
Keep persistence access behind the data access layer and away from HTTP handlers.
SQL access belongs in repositories rather than route handlers.
Every API request payload must be validated before calling services.
Check incoming endpoint input before it reaches the service layer.
Validate external request parameters at the API boundary before service invocation.
Behavior changes should include a regression test before merge.
Add tests that reproduce the bug whenever behavior is corrected.
Require a regression spec for user-visible behavior changes.
Do not swallow exceptions; propagate or handle the error explicitly.
Errors should be handled explicitly instead of disappearing inside catch blocks.
Never ignore a failure in a catch path; return or rethrow it deliberately.
